measurement_notes.target_body_statistics: Serialized task-region byte and operation counts are wrapper statistics over the exact C++ replay/candidate MLIR. Fresh task costs come from C++ score rows; actual compiled II comes from compiler-emitted native mapped MLIR.
measurement_notes.native_cycles: Whole-program cycle counts from the per-candidate native ledger; separate from C++ predicted whole-program cycles and per-task predicted durations.
measurement_notes.resource_counts: Fields named whole_program_cgras_* are the sum of per-task CGRA allocations across the workflow candidate. Tasks reuse the physical grid over time, so this sum is not physical hardware size, simultaneous demand, or peak occupancy. Hardware is 16 CGRAs and 64 PEs; this receipt reports no observed peak-occupancy value.
